## Appearance

Margaret has soft, pale brown hair and an elfin, sweet, little white face. She is noted for her long, slender fingers, which are tanned from being a shore girl.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015)_

## History

Prior to her memory inspiring a novel, Margaret had a story published in the [Canadian Woman](../codex/factions.md#canadian-woman) while studying as a Junior girl at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Years later, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) obtained Captain Jim's enthusiastic approval to write a novel centered around his life-book and the memory of lost Margaret.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P46](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_
